en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of substantial late‑19th/early‑20th‑century urban buildings behind a tree‑lined street and brick/stone perimeter wall. The main structure on the left is a richly decorated brick and stone mansion or civic building with a steep hipped roof, dormers and elaborate window pediments. To the right stands a slightly newer villa with a large, curved gable and simple classical detailing. In the background are more institutional‑looking blocks with steep tiled roofs, chimneys and small tower‑like roof structures. Leafless trees and empty street suggest late autumn or winter. No visible caption or border text appears on the image.
